title: Manager (M1)- FinOps
jobDescription:
Job Description – Fin Ops Manager

ROLE:
Fin Ops Manager Experience: 3–6 Years Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) Location: Mumbai (Malad) About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Fin Ops Manager to lead critical financial operations across fund flow management, escrow reconciliations, settlements, and financial controls. The role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of lender and borrower fund movements while maintaining compliance with RBI regulations. The ideal candidate should have experience in fintech, banking, NBFCs, or payments, with a strong inclination towards process automation and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities
1. Fund Flow & Risk Management Monitor and validate daily borrower and lender escrow balances. Ensure seamless execution of T+1 settlements in accordance with RBI guidelines. Track idle funds, settlement delays, and fund variances, ensuring timely resolution. Monitor operational risks associated with fund movement and implement preventive controls. Ensure compliance with RBI Digital Lending and P2P regulations across all financial operations. Maintain complete documentation, audit trails, and operational logs for regulatory and internal audits. Support compliance reviews, audit observations, and closure of action items.
2. Lender–Borrower Fund Matching Oversee lender-to-borrower fund allocation processes for both manual and automated lending. Validate allocation logic to ensure accurate fund deployment. Monitor mismatches, exceptions, and reassignment scenarios, ensuring timely resolution. Continuously improve allocation accuracy and operational efficiency.
3. Escrow Reconciliation & Financial Controls Perform and oversee daily reconciliations across: Escrow accounts vs. Internal Systems Payment Gateway settlements vs. Bank Credits Disbursement transactions vs. Payout confirmations Investigate reconciliation breaks and ensure timely closure. Ensure 100% accuracy in financial reporting and operational reconciliations. Strengthen reconciliation controls to minimize operational and financial risks.
4. Cost Optimization & Operational Efficiency Analyze payment gateway charges, payout costs, banking fees, and other Fin Ops expenses. Identify opportunities to optimize transaction costs through routing improvements, automation, and process redesign. Monitor cost-per-transaction metrics and develop management dashboards for leadership. Drive initiatives to improve operational efficiency without compromising controls.
5. Process Improvement & Automation Partner with Product and Technology teams to automate manual financial operations, including: Escrow reconciliations Settlement processes Payment gateway reconciliation Mandate tracking Contribute to the design of Fin Ops dashboards, monitoring frameworks, and operational reporting. Participate in UAT for product and technology releases impacting financial operations and fund flow processes. Recommend scalable solutions to improve operational resilience and efficiency. Required Qualifications & Skills Must Have Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA). 3–6 years of experience in Fin Tech, NBFC, Banking, Payments, or Financial Operations. Strong understanding of financial systems, reconciliations, internal controls, and audit processes. Hands-on experience managing high-volume financial transactions with exceptional accuracy. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. High attention to detail with a strong ownership mindset. Ability to perform effectively in time-sensitive and high-accountability environments. Excellent collaboration skills with Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, and Compliance teams. Good to Have Experience driving automation initiatives or working closely with Product and Engineering teams. Working knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Drona, or similar analytics tools. Understanding of payment gateway ecosystems, settlement routing, and payout infrastructure. Familiarity with RBI regulations governing Digital Lending, P2P Lending, and escrow operations. What We're Looking For A proactive problem solver who can identify financial and operational risks before they become issues. Someone who enjoys building scalable, automated financial operations rather than relying on manual processes. A professional who balances strong financial controls with operational efficiency. A collaborative individual capable of working across multiple functions to improve end-to-end fund management processes. A data-driven leader who can leverage analytics to improve cost, accuracy, and operational performance.

title: Operation - Associate (A3)
jobDescription:
Job Description – Senior Operations Executive

ROLE:
Operations Executive Experience: 2–5 Years Location: Mumbai (Malad) About the Role We are looking for a highly responsible and detail-oriented Operations Executive to manage critical financial and operational processes within our lending business. This role involves handling reconciliations, payment operations, NACH activities, partner settlements, and operational issue resolution. Since the role directly impacts customer funds and financial accuracy, we are looking for someone who demonstrates exceptional ownership, discipline, and accountability in every task they undertake. The ideal candidate should have prior experience in the lending, NBFC, or Fin Tech industry and be committed to delivering operational excellence while continuously improving processes and controls. Key Responsibilities Financial Operations & Reconciliation Perform daily reconciliations between internal systems and designated bank accounts, ensuring complete accuracy. Investigate reconciliation breaks, identify root causes, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely closure. Monitor daily transaction reports and ensure all operational exceptions are resolved within defined timelines. Ensure operational records and financial reports are accurate, complete, and audit-ready. Payment Operations Manage partner invoicing and merchant payment processes with accuracy and timeliness. Coordinate settlement activities with internal Finance, Operations, and external partners. Monitor payment failures, pending transactions, and settlement delays, ensuring prompt resolution. Support fund flow activities and transaction monitoring across operational workflows. NACH Operations Handle end-to-end NACH operations, including mandate registration, updation, presentation, and monitoring. Track NACH success and failure reports and coordinate corrective actions where necessary. Ensure all NACH activities are executed within operational timelines and regulatory requirements. Stakeholder Coordination Respond to operational queries from customers, business partners, and internal stakeholders. Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues efficiently. Provide timely and accurate updates to stakeholders while maintaining high service standards. Process Improvement Identify recurring operational issues, process gaps, and control weaknesses. Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce operational risk. Actively participate in system enhancements, testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new features impacting operations. Contribute towards building scalable and efficient operational processes. Operational Governance Ensure adherence to internal SOPs, operational controls, and compliance requirements. Maintain complete documentation for operational activities and support audit requirements. Escalate operational risks, discrepancies, and critical issues in a timely manner. Qualifications & Skills Must Have 2–5 years of experience in Operations within the Lending, NBFC, Banking, or Fin Tech industry. Strong understanding of reconciliation processes and financial operations. Hands-on experience in NACH mandate management and presentation processes. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the Microsoft Office Suite. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting strict timelines. Comfortable working in a fast-paced and process-driven environment. Good to Have Experience in fund flow management and settlement operations. Knowledge of payment gateways, escrow accounts, and digital payment ecosystems. Exposure to lending products, repayment operations, and financial reconciliations. Experience working with operational dashboards and reporting tools. Who We're Looking For This role is not just about executing operational tasks—it is about safeguarding financial accuracy and ensuring operational integrity. We are looking for someone who understands the responsibility that comes with handling customer funds and financial transactions. The ideal candidate will: Have exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify even the smallest discrepancies. Demonstrate a high level of ownership and accountability, taking complete responsibility for assigned work from start to finish. Be disciplined, dependable, and committed to delivering accurate outcomes within strict timelines. Exercise sound judgment while handling financial operations where errors can have a direct customer and business impact. Be proactive in identifying risks, highlighting issues early, and driving them to closure. Remain calm and focused under pressure while maintaining a high standard of quality. Be a quick learner who readily adapts to new systems, processes, and business requirements. Collaborate effectively across teams while communicating clearly and professionally. Continuously look for opportunities to improve processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency. Uphold the highest standards of integrity, accuracy, and professionalism in every aspect of their work.

title: Growth Manager - Acquisition
jobDescription: Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience 7–8 years of experience in growth or performance marketing, with direct ownership of paid acquisition at consumer scale Experience owning CAC and acquisition efficiency end to end — budget, bidding, and channel mix Hands-on experience running paid channels (Google, Meta, Linked In) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content, referral) Experience working cross-functionally with product, tech, and data teams Preferred Qualifications Experience scaling acquisition in a fintech or wealthtech product, or for a financially sophisticated / high-value audience Proficiency in cohort-level CAC analysis, funnel diagnostics, and bid and budget optimisation Hands-on experience with marketing attribution and mobile measurement platforms Track record of lowering CAC or improving ROAS while scaling spend, not at the cost of quality Experience briefing channel- and cohort-specific landing pages and creative — and reading what converts About the Role Acquisition is not about volume. It is about bringing the right customer in, at the right cost, with the right first impression. This role owns that. Len Den Club is India's leading P2P lending platform — RBI-regulated, and in the middle of its most ambitious growth phase yet. This is not a maintenance role on a stable channel mix. Spend is scaling fast, the audience spans first-time investors to seasoned high-value ones, and the difference between a good and a great acquisition engine shows up directly in CAC, conversion, and the quality of capital that enters the platform. Responsibilities Own paid acquisition end to end across Google, Meta, and Linked In — strategy, budget, bidding, and continuous optimisation Build and scale organic acquisition across SEO, ASO, content, and referral Own CAC and acquisition efficiency — analyse at cohort level, kill what's expensive, double down on what compounds Partner with tech and data to ensure every rupee of spend is attributable — no blind decisions Brief and iterate channel- and cohort-specific landing pages and creative; close the loop on what actually converts Translate acquisition data into decisions — weekly and monthly reporting with clear recommendations, not just charts

Dynamic, fast-paced work environment with significant learning and career growth opportunities. Chance to contribute to strategic initiatives including fundraising, corporate restructuring, and governance transformation.

Analytics, Attribution & Reporting • Generate weekly and monthly reporting for CAC, ROAS, activation cohorts, revenue metrics, channel performance, user quality, and funnel conversion. • Monitor attribution and campaign performance using tools such as Apps Flyer, Adjust, Branch, GA4, Mixpanel, and Clevertap. • Curate actionable insights from Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, analytics platforms, and attribution systems. • Validate optimization hypotheses through structured A/B testing and cohort analysis. Success Metrics • Scale high-quality user acquisition profitably. • Improve activation rates for quality users • Maintain sustainable CAC and healthy LTV:CAC benchmarks. • Improve overall funnel efficiency and user quality. • Drive channel diversification and scalable growth opportunities. • Build AI-enabled operating efficiencies within performance marketing workflows.
